'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament Scott Church DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Church]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35795 Scott Church's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Sabaac]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225348/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35795 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Church]]
* '''Event:''' [[2006 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' 6 V-Card Tournament
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Original post ==

'''Scott Church's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Sabaac'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' November 8, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Scott Church's Dark Side Cloud City Sabaac Deck that he used for the 6 V-Card Tournament

=== Strategy ===

This deck went 2-1, with a bye, a timed win against Brian Fred and a loss to Brant Wood.
